answer: Path Disjointness Routing Threshold. Nodes route transactions exclusively through graph neighborhoods lacking a common articulation point, verified via a cryptographic walnut distribution. Attackers pay by needing exponentially denser physical infrastructure to maintain parallel fake nodes without sharing routing bottlenecks, because every single active thread across the topology must traverse strictly independent network segments.
